$comment: A LANGUAGE prior. Data only, no code. Measured off real public-domain Japanese prose by scripts/build-lang-prior-ja.mjs — the engine receives it through bin/priors/lang/, nothing in packages/ hardcodes any of it.

provenance.source: scripts/build-lang-prior-ja.mjs — measured from udhr-jpn.txt; udhr-jpn_osaka.txt; udhr-jpn_tokyo.txt; aozora789_Wagahaiwa_Nekodearu__Natsume_Soseki_.txt
provenance.built_by: scripts/build-lang-prior-ja.mjs (absorption: rules read off the corpus, never asserted)
provenance.corpus_register: Two registers, pooled: modern legal (UN Universal Declaration of Human Rights, Japanese, OHCHR) and Meiji-era literary (Aozora Bunko #789, Natsume Sōseki's 吾輩は猫である 1905–06, 新字新仮名, public domain)

declared_params.qualification_rule: count >= 5 AND <50% of occurrences bound inside tokens (digit.digit or letter.letter) — line-break boundary tests are Latin-brained and were measured failing on unspaced scripts

notes: @3 (2026-08-21) adds sentence_terminators/closing_quote_chars alongside @2's additive-provenance keys — additive only; @1/@2 files remain valid and mean the same thing they always meant.
The engine's frozen default set (spans.js SENTENCE_TERMINATORS, giver script/latn) covers . ! ? … — this prior EXTENDS reception to fullwidth marks (。！？…), it does not replace the Latin defaults.
Ellipsis '…' qualified only if measured above; single-character '…' vs two-cell '……' both reduce to the same code point.
Segmentation (unspaced text -> word surfaces) is NOT claimed by this prior — that is a different organ and a different measurement.

relation_case_markers feeds perceiver/text/case-relations.js, the layer UNDERNEATH SVO word order: role is read off the received particle, not position. The role MAPPING (は/が -> subject, を -> object) is closed-class linguistic knowledge declared in this builder's CASE_MARKER_CANDIDATES; the corpus measurement decides which candidates are real here. Consumed only when a document declares language "ja".
